bia, ac luctuosa fuisse, casu quo

page.notes: Chrysost. / Homil. 26. in 2. Corinth. are the right-margin references beside the first paragraph; they are placed as one note. Long s is read as s throughout. The hyphen in "Chryso-" and "lu-do" is printed. Some letters near the ink blots at "vel ipsum" and "infausto" are faint but read with reasonable confidence. The word "feriâ" was read as "seriâ" after the printed f, which has the form of a long s, so it is marked as read; no [?] was needed.
